questions.question: Select the option that corrects the misspelt words in the given sentence.

options.text: He was conscentious about following the doctor's orders.
He was conscentious about folowing the doctor's ordars.
He was conscientious about following the doctor's orders.
He was conscintious about folowing the doctor's ordars.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'He was conscientious about following the doctor's orders.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options the correct answer is** Option 3.**
 
• Here, the correctly spelt words are** 'Conscientious, following, and orders'.**
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Conscientious**: (used about people) careful to do something correctly and well. [(व्‍यक्ति) ईमानदार, कर्तव्यनिष्‍ठ]
 
• **Following**: to do something or to happen according to instructions, an example, what is usual, etc. (निर्देशों के अनुसार काम करना या होना; पालन या अनुसरण करना)
 
• **Order**: the way in which people or things are arranged in relation to each other. (व्‍यवस्थित क्रम, सिलसिला)
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *He was **conscientious** about **following** the doctor's **orders**.*
